test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Feb, 2026 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
There are four underlined words in the sentence given below. One of them is misspelt. Choose the option with the misspelt word.

The project faced delays due to __bureaucratic__ hurdles, lack of co-ordination, and the __inconsistant__ __approach__ of the __contractors__.
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. inconsistant is misspelt.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **inconsistant** in the sentence is incorrect.
 
• The correct spelling is **inconsistent**.
 
• All other underlined words are spelled correctly:
 
 
• **Bureaucratic** is correctly spelled.
 
• **Approach** is correctly spelled.
 
• **Contractors** is correctly spelled.
 
 

Correct sentence: *The project faced delays due to bureaucratic hurdles, lack of co-ordination, and the **inconsistent** approach of the contractors.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Commonly confused words:**
 
 
• **Inconsistant** is a common misspelling of the word **inconsistent**, which means not staying the same or not acting in a predictable or uniform way.
 
• It’s important to carefully proofread sentences to avoid such errors.
 
 
 
• **Spelling Tip:**
 
 
• Remember that words ending in **"-ent"** often denote an adjective (e.g., consistent, persistent, efficient).
